pairs.target: yuēdìng de xiàwǔ , wéi lǎoshī dài tǎ wéi chuānguò xuégōng cè yuàn , yuàn hòu shí dìshàng huàzhe liǎngdào báixiàn , sòng yuǎn zhèngzài bǎ dìshàng de xiǎoshízǐ sǎo kāi .
pairs.english: That agreed afternoon, Instructor Vey led Tavi through the academy’s side courtyard; two white lines marked the stone ground behind it, where Song Yuan was sweeping away small stones on the ground.
pairs.hanzi: 约定的下午，维老师带塔维穿过学宫侧院，院后石地上划着两道白线，宋远正在把地上的小石子扫开。

pairs.target: nài lěi zuòzài qiángbiān , zuǒbì réng tuō zhe , jiàn tāmen lái , zhǐ bǎ shēnbiān yìzhāng kōng dèng wǎng wài nuó le nuó , méiyǒu zhàn qǐlái tì sòng yuǎn jièshào .
pairs.english: Nerai sat by the wall, her left arm still supported; seeing them arrive, she merely shifted an empty stool beside her outward, without standing to introduce Song Yuan.
pairs.hanzi: 奈蕾坐在墙边，左臂仍托着，见他们来，只把身边一张空凳往外挪了挪，没有站起来替宋远介绍。

pairs.target: lìng yíwèi liáng jiàoxí ná zhe liàn dāo , bǐ sòng yuǎn gāo xiē , dāorèn bāo le hòu bù , táishǒu shí xiān wèn sòng yuǎn , jīntiān hái ràng buràng tā pèng nà kuài jiù mùtou .
pairs.english: The other instructor, Liang, held a practice blade and was taller than Song Yuan; its edge wrapped in thick cloth, he raised it and first asked Song Yuan if he would still let him hit that old wood today.
pairs.hanzi: 另一位梁教习拿着练刀，比宋远高些，刀刃包了厚布，抬手时先问宋远，今天还让不让他碰那块旧木头。

pairs.target: sòng yuǎn shuō mùtou guī mùtou , biétì tā shěnglì , zhuǎntóu tóngtǎ wéi shuō zhàn zàixiàn wài , búlùn diào le shénme dōu bié shēnshǒu jiǎn .
pairs.english: Song Yuan said wood was wood and not to spare him; turning to Tavi, he told him to stay outside the lines and never reach to pick up anything that fell.
pairs.hanzi: 宋远说木头归木头，别替他省力，转头同塔维说站在线外，不论掉了什么都别伸手捡。

pairs.target: dìyī xià bǐ tǎ wéi xiǎng de kuài , sòng yuǎn hái zài nuó jiǎo , liáng jiàoxí de dāo biàn dǎ zài dùn yán , shēngyīn chén de bú xiàng liǎnggēn mùgān xiāngpèng .
pairs.english: The first strike was faster than Tavi expected; Song Yuan was still shifting his feet when Liang’s blade struck the shield rim, with a sound much deeper than two wooden poles meeting.
pairs.hanzi: 第一下比塔维想的快，宋远还在挪脚，梁教习的刀便打在盾沿，声音沉得不像两根木杆相碰。

pairs.target: duǎn dùn xiàngcèmiàn fān , sòng yuǎn shùnzhe dāo tuì bànbù , mùzhàng cóng xiàfāng shēnchū , méi pèngdào rén biàn bèi dāobèi bōkāi .
pairs.english: The short shield turned sideways; Song Yuan retreated half a step with the blade, his wooden staff reaching out below, only to be knocked aside by the blade’s back before touching anyone.
pairs.hanzi: 短盾向侧面翻，宋远顺着刀退半步，木杖从下方伸出，没碰到人便被刀背拨开。

pairs.target: liáng jiàoxí gēnshàng yíbù , sòng yuǎn de jiǎo yǐ pèngdào báixiàn , tā méiyǒu yìngchēng , kāikǒu jiàotíng , dāo biàn tíng zài tā jiān páng .
pairs.english: Liang followed a step, Song Yuan’s foot already at the white line; he did not force it, called a halt, and the blade then stopped beside his shoulder.
pairs.hanzi: 梁教习跟上一步，宋远的脚已碰到白线，他没有硬撑，开口叫停，刀便停在他肩旁。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi lián nà shēng tíng dōu méi láidejí tīng quán , yuánxiān xiǎng hǎo de kàn shǒu , kàn jiǎo , yíxià biànchéng le nǎér dōu xiǎng kàn .
pairs.english: Tavi barely had time to hear the whole call to stop; his earlier plan to watch hands and feet suddenly became wanting to look everywhere.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维连那声停都没来得及听全，原先想好的看手、看脚，一下变成了哪儿都想看。

pairs.target: sòng yuǎn róu le yíxià jiān , wèn tā kànjiàn méiyǒu , tǎ wéi shuō kànjiàn le dāo , liáng jiàoxí xiào , shuō nà yǐjīng bǐ bìyǎn hǎo .
pairs.english: Song Yuan rubbed his shoulder and asked whether he had seen; Tavi said he had seen the blade, and Liang laughed, saying that was already better than closing his eyes.
pairs.hanzi: 宋远揉了一下肩，问他看见没有，塔维说看见了刀，梁教习笑，说那已经比闭眼好。

pairs.target: xiūxi shí sòng yuǎn bǎ dùn fānguòlái , gěi tāmen kàn mù miàn biānyuán yíkuài néng tuì jìn qiǎn cáo de hù piàn , xiàmiàn zhèng tuō zhe zuótiān nà piàn duǎn tiě .
pairs.english: At the break Song Yuan turned the shield over and showed them a guard plate along the wooden face’s edge that could yield into a shallow slot, supported below by yesterday’s short iron strip.
pairs.hanzi: 休息时宋远把盾翻过来，给他们看木面边缘一块能退进浅槽的护片，下面正托着昨天那片短铁。

pairs.target: tiě zài liǎngduān mù zuò jiān yǒu yìxiǎo jié néng wān , dùn miàn shòu tuī shí , hù piàn zhǐnéng tuì yǒuxiàn de yìdiǎn , wàicè de cáo jiān lán zhe , búhuì zhěngkuài fānkāi .
pairs.english: A short section of iron could bend between the two wooden seats; when the shield face was pushed, the guard could move back only a limited amount, the outer slot shoulder stopping it from flipping open completely.
pairs.hanzi: 铁在两端木座间有一小截能弯，盾面受推时，护片只能退有限的一点，外侧的槽肩拦着，不会整块翻开。

pairs.target: mùzhàng bǐng biān lìng yípiàn tiězé hù zheshǒu , liǎngpiàn luǒ miàn dōu liúzài wò bǐng shí shǒuzhǎng néng tiē dào de wèizhì , méiyǒu jiào shuí gé zhe mùtou zhǎo .
pairs.english: The other iron strip beside the staff grip meanwhile guarded the hand; both bare surfaces were where palms could touch while gripping, with no one asked to find them through wood.
pairs.hanzi: 木杖柄边另一片铁则护着手，两片裸面都留在握柄时手掌能贴到的位置，没有叫谁隔着木头找。

pairs.target: sòng yuǎn qǔ xià liǎngpiàn , gèzì chá guò biānyuán hé kèxiàn , zhuāng huí zuò lǐ , zài yòng tóng yíkuài xiǎo yā mù shì le tuìràng , wéi lǎoshī zhàn jìn kàn wán cái huídào xiàn wài .
pairs.english: Song Yuan removed both strips, checked each edge and mark, refitted them in their seats and then tested their yielding with the same small wooden press block; Instructor Vey watched up close before returning outside the lines.
pairs.hanzi: 宋远取下两片，各自查过边缘和刻线，装回座里，再用同一块小压木试了退让，维老师站近看完才回到线外。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi wèn shìbushì ràng dùn nà piàn nán wān xiē , sòng yuǎn shuō fǎnguòlái , zhè yìhuí yào tā duō ràng yìdiǎn , zhàng biān nà piàn jiù huì shǎo ràng , huàn le wèizhì bùnéng zhàobān .
pairs.english: Tavi asked if the shield strip should become harder to bend; Song Yuan said the reverse: this time it should yield a little more, and the staff strip would yield less; a different position could not be treated identically.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维问是不是让盾那片难弯些，宋远说反过来，这一回要它多让一点，杖边那片就会少让，换了位置不能照搬。

pairs.target: tā méiyǒu ràng liáng jiàoxí děng zhe áidǎ , chóngxīn zhàn dào báixiàn zhōngjiān , jiào duìfāng zìjǐ zhǎokōng chù , zìjǐ yě bǎ liǎng zhǎng tiē huí wò bǐng de luǒ miàn , jiāng nà yìdiǎn biànhuà wěnzhù .
pairs.english: He did not have Liang wait to be hit, but stood between the white lines again, told him to find an opening himself, and pressed both palms back to the grip’s bare surfaces, steadying that small change.
pairs.hanzi: 他没有让梁教习等着挨打，重新站到白线中间，叫对方自己找空处，自己也把两掌贴回握柄的裸面，将那一点变化稳住。

pairs.target: dìèrcì dāo cóng wàicè xiéyā guòlái , sòng yuǎn zuǒjiǎo nuókāi , dùn yán jiē zhù de nàyíkè , hù piàn bǐ gāngcái tuì de shēn , dāo gēnzhe huá le yìxiǎo jié .
pairs.english: The second time the blade pressed diagonally from outside; Song Yuan moved his left foot, and as the shield rim caught it, the guard yielded deeper than before and the blade slid a short way with it.
pairs.hanzi: 第二次刀从外侧斜压过来，宋远左脚挪开，盾沿接住的那一刻，护片比刚才退得深，刀跟着滑了一小截。

pairs.target: bìng méiyǒu yìshēng jùxiǎng , tǎ wéi zhǐ kànjiàn liáng jiàoxí de shǒu xiàng wài piān , sòng yuǎn de duǎn zhàng yǐ cóng dùn xià shēnguòqù , zài yāo biān de hùdiàn shàng diǎn le yíxià .
pairs.english: There was not a great crash; Tavi only saw Liang’s hand veer outward, and Song Yuan’s short staff was already under the shield, reaching toward his waist to tap the pad.
pairs.hanzi: 并没有一声巨响，塔维只看见梁教习的手向外偏，宋远的短杖已从盾下伸过去，在腰边的护垫上点了一下。

pairs.target: liáng jiàoxí lìkè shōu dāo , sòng yuǎn jiàotíng , liǎng zhǎng réng tiēzhe tiě , dītóu bǎ biànhuà shōuhuí , suíhòu cái sōngshǒu , ná yā mù chóngxīn shì guò .
pairs.english: Liang withdrew the blade immediately, Song Yuan called a halt, both palms still on the iron; he lowered his head and cancelled the change before letting go, testing again with the press block.
pairs.hanzi: 梁教习立刻收刀，宋远叫停，两掌仍贴着铁，低头把变化收回，随后才松手，拿压木重新试过。

pairs.target: dùn shàng āohén hái zài , hù piàn de tuìràng què huídào yuánlái de wèizhì , zhàng biān nà piàn yě chá le , sòng yuǎn cái bǎ liǎngjiàn dōngxī fàngxià .
pairs.english: The dent remained on the shield, but the guard’s yielding returned to its original position; after checking the staff strip too, only then Song Yuan put both implements down.
pairs.hanzi: 盾上凹痕还在，护片的退让却回到原来的位置，杖边那片也查了，宋远才把两件东西放下。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi píngzhù de qì zhè cái tǔchūlái , tā yǐwéi zìjǐ huì kànjiàn yíjiàn dōngxī měngde biànchéng lìng yíjiàn , shíjì zuì yàojǐn de yíxià , jīhū méi gěi tā kànqīng .
pairs.english: Only then did Tavi let out the breath he had held; he had expected to see one thing suddenly become another, but the crucial moment had barely allowed him a clear look.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维屏住的气这才吐出来，他以为自己会看见一件东西猛地变成另一件，实际最要紧的一下，几乎没给他看清。

pairs.target: liáng jiàoxí jiēkāi hùdiàn kàn le yǎn , méi shuō zài lái yícì gěi xuéshēng kàn , fǎnér wèn sòng yuǎn , zìjǐ ruò zài dùn biān tíng dāo , tā zhǔnbèi wǎng nǎér zǒu .
pairs.english: Liang lifted the pad to look, did not ask for a repeat for the student, and instead asked Song Yuan where he planned to go if the blade stopped by the shield.
pairs.hanzi: 梁教习揭开护垫看了眼，没说再来一次给学生看，反而问宋远，自己若在盾边停刀，他准备往哪儿走。

pairs.target: sòng yuǎn méi dá , ná qǐ yǐjīng huīfù yuányàng de dùn zhàng , diǎntóu shìyì jìxù , zhèhuí méiyǒu chóngxīn zuò jiè xìng de biànhuà .
pairs.english: Song Yuan did not answer, picked up the shield and staff already restored to normal, and nodded to continue; this time he did not make the property exchange again.
pairs.hanzi: 宋远没答，拿起已经恢复原样的盾杖，点头示意继续，这回没有重新作借性的变化。

pairs.target: liáng jiàoxí bǎ dāo dì dào tóngyígè fāngxiàng , dāojiān gāng dào dùn qián biàn shōuzhù , jiǎo què huàn dào lìngyícè , sòng yuǎn de dùn gēn chūqù , yāo biān kōng le .
pairs.english: Liang offered the blade from the same direction, its tip then stopping just before the shield while stepping to the other side; Song Yuan’s shield followed, exposing his waist.
pairs.hanzi: 梁教习把刀递到同一个方向，刀尖刚到盾前便收住，脚却换到另一侧，宋远的盾跟出去，腰边空了。

pairs.target: nà yí xiàluò zài hùdiàn shàng , shēngyīn bù xiǎng , sòng yuǎn què xī le kǒuqì , wǎnghòu tuìchū báixiàn , táiqǐ zhàng shuō gòu le .
pairs.english: That blow landed on the pad without much sound, but Song Yuan drew a breath, backed beyond the white line and raised his staff, saying enough.
pairs.hanzi: 那一下落在护垫上，声音不响，宋远却吸了口气，往后退出白线，抬起杖说够了。

pairs.target: tā éjiǎo yǒu hàn , shǒuzhǐ sōng le yòu hé , wéi lǎoshī wèn yǒuméiyǒu fāmá , tā shuō méiyǒu , děng qì píng le , yòu zìjǐ mōlemō liǎngpiàn tiě .
pairs.english: There was sweat at his temple; his fingers opened and closed, and Instructor Vey asked about numbness; he said none, waited until his breathing settled and felt both iron strips himself again.
pairs.hanzi: 他额角有汗，手指松了又合，维老师问有没有发麻，他说没有，等气平了，又自己摸了摸两片铁。

pairs.target: nài lěi cóng qiángbiān shuō tā gāngcái nà yíbù tài tān , sòng yuǎn shuō tā de zuǒshǒu yǎng hǎo le zài lái mà , liáng jiàoxí què zài pángbiān diǎntóu , shuō zhè jù tā méi mà cuò .
pairs.english: From the wall Nerai said that last step had been greedy; Song Yuan said she could scold once her left hand healed, but Liang nodded beside him and said she was right about that.
pairs.hanzi: 奈蕾从墙边说他刚才那一步太贪，宋远说她的左手养好了再来骂，梁教习却在旁边点头，说这句她没骂错。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi kànzhe dìshàng de liǎngchuàn jiǎoyìn , wèn zuìhòu yícì wèishénme búyòng gāngcái nà diǎn biànhuà , sòng yuǎn bǎ zhàng fàngzài xī shàng , shuō yòng le yě búhuì tì tā kànjiàn nà zhī jiǎo .
pairs.english: Tavi looked at the two trails of footprints on the ground and asked why he had not used that change the last time; Song Yuan rested the staff on his knees and said it would not have seen that foot for him anyway.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维看着地上的两串脚印，问最后一次为什么不用刚才那点变化，宋远把杖放在膝上，说用了也不会替他看见那只脚。

pairs.target: tā jiēzhe shuō zìjǐ shǒulǐ zhè liǎngpiàn shú de bùnéng zài shú , zhǎo hǎo nà yíxià réng yào fēnshén , búshì duìmiàn yídòng , tā biàn néng xuǎnchū suǒyǒu gāi zuò de shì .
pairs.english: He added that these two strips in his hands were utterly familiar, yet finding that moment still took attention; the opponent moving did not let him choose everything he ought to do.
pairs.hanzi: 他接着说自己手里这两片熟得不能再熟，找好那一下仍要分神，不是对面一动，他便能选出所有该做的事。

pairs.target: liáng jiàoxí jiāng liàn dāo dìgěi pángbiān de xuéshēng shōu hǎo , shuō míngtiān tā tóng biérén liàn , biérén wèibì ná dāo , yě wèibì kěn xiān pèng dùn .
pairs.english: Liang handed the practice blade to a student beside him to put away, saying tomorrow he would practise with someone else who might not carry a blade or agree to hit the shield first.
pairs.hanzi: 梁教习将练刀递给旁边的学生收好，说明天他同别人练，别人未必拿刀，也未必肯先碰盾。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi hūrán xiǎngqǐ nàgēn nǔ , wèn yàoshi liǎnggè rén cóng qiánhòu guòlái ne , sòng yuǎn kàn le yìyǎn nài lěi , méiyǒu ná jīntiān de báixiàn tì nàtiān de shānlù zuò dáàn .
pairs.english: Tavi suddenly remembered the crossbow and asked what if two people came from front and back; Song Yuan glanced at Nerai, without making today’s white lines an answer for that day’s mountain road.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维忽然想起那根弩，问要是两个人从前后过来呢，宋远看了一眼奈蕾，没有拿今天的白线替那天的山路作答案。

pairs.target: tā shuō nà jiù gèng děi rènqīng zìjǐ méiyǒu tóngshí kànjiàn shénme , néng xiān pǎo dào búyòng liǎngtóu áidǎ de dìfāng , biàn bié wèile bǎ zhè yìzhāo shǐ chūlái zhànzhù .
pairs.english: He said that made it still more necessary to know what he had not seen at once; if he could reach somewhere he would not be hit from both sides, he should not stop just to use this move.
pairs.hanzi: 他说那就更得认清自己没有同时看见什么，能先跑到不用两头挨打的地方，便别为了把这一招使出来站住。

alignment.english: that made it still more necessary
what he had not seen at once
alignment.hanzi: 自己没有同时看见什么

alignment.english: he would not be hit from both sides

pairs.target: wéi lǎoshī wèn tǎ wéi jīntiān hái xiǎng buxiǎng xué , tā diǎntóu , bǐ láishí màn , què méiyǒu bǎ nà jù xiǎng xué gǎichéng biéde .
pairs.english: Instructor Vey asked Tavi if he still wanted to learn today; he nodded more slowly than when he came, but did not change that wish to learn into something else.
pairs.hanzi: 维老师问塔维今天还想不想学，他点头，比来时慢，却没有把那句想学改成别的。

alignment.english: if he still wanted to learn

pairs.target: huíqù shí tā de yòushǒu réng bāo zhe bù , zuǒshǒu zài yī biān qīngqīng bǎidòng , zǒu dào zhǎi ménqián , tā xiān cèshēn ràng guò yíngmiàn de rén , cái fāxiànzìjǐ méiyǒu dīng zhe duìfāng shǒulǐ de mùgān .
pairs.english: On the way back his right hand remained bandaged, his left swinging lightly beside his coat; at the narrow gate he first turned to let someone coming toward him pass, only then noticing he had not stared at what the other person held—a wooden pole.
pairs.hanzi: 回去时他的右手仍包着布，左手在衣边轻轻摆动，走到窄门前，他先侧身让过迎面的人，才发现自己没有盯着对方手里的木杆。
